heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 94–455, title XIX, § 1901(a)(49), Oct. 4, 1976, 90 Stat. 1773]

notes.text: Section, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 119, related to cross reference for rules relating to effect on earnings and profits of transactions to which this part applies.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective for taxable years beginning after Dec. 31, 1976, see section 1901(d) of Pub. L. 94–455, set out as an Effective Date of 1976 Amendment note under section 2 of this title.
